service.description: Connection diagnostics for a saved NetSuite OAuth2 auth profile. Registered on the SourceSystemConnector NETSUITE row as healthCheckServiceName and invoked only through facade.SettingsFacadeServices.test#SourceConnection, which owns the permission gate. Read-only: one token and a one-row SuiteQL query. Never writes to ec.message: a refused credential is a check row, not a service error.

parameter.name: stage
parameter.description: Run just this stage and report the next one, so the caller can show progress as each completes. Blank runs every stage in a single call.

parameter.name: nextStage
parameter.description: Stage to run next, or blank when the probe is finished — either it completed or a failure made the remaining stages meaningless.
